bd_default.rule: a flow day with net flow F_t greater than zero is linked at START: r_t = V_t / (V_(t-1) + F_t) - 1, guarded at 2 pct of |V_(t-1)|; a flow day with F_t zero or negative is linked at END: r_t = (V_t - F_t) / V_(t-1) - 1; the segment's first day keeps its served return
bd_default.source: learn.bdreporting.com article/97 (Calculations: Performance Calculations), the published default cited by the task order; not fetched by this worker

end.rule: every flow day is linked at the END of its day: r_t = (V_t - F_t) / V_(t-1) - 1; the segment's first day keeps its served return
end.source: the served behaviour: the served system links every flow at the END of its day (task order DB-b-166; served values read from the stored tables, not from S3)

limits: The count describes the 88 flow-bearing gradable segments in worker 108's stored tables (90 segments read, 2 with no flow day) and the two named conventions only: bd_default as declared here and end as the served behaviour. It says nothing about any other timing, any other Black Diamond default or on-request setting, or which convention the firm's accounts actually use beyond these stored segments.
